contracts: (Aggregate status equals invalid whenever required matrix evidence is absent or unexecuted.) AND (All applicable Consumers restore Prior Route identity and verdict/diagnostic baseline.) AND (For any required stale matrix evidence, validator exits with an invalid aggregate status and identifies the stale artifact; no valid aggregate is emitted.) AND (Fresh-checkout semantic verdict equals the reference verdict and pinned-input provenance is complete.) AND (The fresh-checkout run emits a coverage result and equality assertion against the pinned reference; the altered-input selector produces a deterministic failure.) AND (仅当 fresh-checkout identities、pinned inputs、重建结果及 reference Exact Cover 全部匹配且回执可追溯时终止为成功，否则为 stale/evidence-invalid/coverage failure。) AND (存在任一基础设施失败或不可执行 case 时，且仅此时，aggregate terminal status 为 invalid 并包含对应 case identity/reason；不得输出 valid。) AND (每个适用 Consumer 均有四步有序真实调用记录，且最终 route identity、verdict、diagnostic 与 Prior baseline 相同。)

Each declared assertion needs a cer_assertion mapping and a meaningful independent oracle. Tests must invoke the real production entry. The plan is not a behavior observation. Keep governance/constraint failures non-authorizing; do not emit expected-red for them. Preserve all bound Given/When/Then and forbidden outcomes. No placeholder pass or synthetic RED.
selector_intents: Alter a pinned input or reference coverage result so the fresh-checkout replay differs; the replay validator must fail deterministically.

Exercise the bound Given/When against the real production entry. Only a failing assertion of the unchanged observable and expected outcome may emit this marker. Expected subject rejection is a passing test when the oracle requires rejection. Import, setup, process launch, timeout and infrastructure faults must never emit this marker. Observable: Exact Cover replay receipt records fresh-checkout identity verification, same pinned inputs, reconstructed coverage graph/result, and byte/semantic equality with the pinned reference. Expected: 回放首先重建并校验所有冻结输入身份，然后以相同绑定身份执行 Exact Cover；产生的 Exact Cover 结果与 pinned-input reference 完全相等，且可由当前执行证据追溯。

Exercise the bound Given/When against the real production entry. Only a failing assertion of the unchanged observable and expected outcome may emit this marker. Expected subject rejection is a passing test when the oracle requires rejection. Import, setup, process launch, timeout and infrastructure faults must never emit this marker. Observable: The replay report records the fresh-checkout coverage result and an equality comparison to the pinned reference result. Expected: Running the evaluation from a fresh checkout with the pinned inputs produces a coverage result byte-for-byte equal to the reference coverage result.

Exercise the bound Given/When against the real production entry. Only a failing assertion of the unchanged observable and expected outcome may emit this marker. Expected subject rejection is a passing test when the oracle requires rejection. Import, setup, process launch, timeout and infrastructure faults must never emit this marker. Observable: The replay result records checkout identity, pinned input identities, semantic verdict, and a passing equality check. Expected: Fresh-checkout execution produces a semantic verdict equal to the recorded reference verdict and reports reproducible pinned-input provenance.
Feed the aggregate validator a stale matrix evidence fixture and assert the validator rejects any valid aggregate outcome.
Remove one pinned input identity; validation must fail closed for incomplete provenance.
Substitute a verdict-affecting pinned input; repeated fresh-checkout runs must deterministically report semantic-verdict mismatch.
使用 Exact Cover replay 的 fresh-checkout fixture，将任一 pinned input、绑定身份或覆盖结果改动，验证回放稳定地产生 stale/coverage mismatch 而非成功。
提供仅含历史 Exact Cover 结果且跳过 fresh reconstruction 的输入，验证命令拒绝无当前执行证据的结果。
构造含明确 infrastructure_failure case receipt 的 aggregate fixture，验证汇总器返回 invalid 而非 valid。
移除基础设施失败观测或伪造成功输出，验证汇总器拒绝不可验证的 aggregate evidence。
运行 Consumer 生命周期负向探针，移除四步中的任一步，验证结果为失败并指出缺失操作。
